description: Services Gluo runs for agents (site checks, screenshots, domain availability, email setup, dependency vulnerabilities, ...), each with its exact input schema. Operations marked free can be called right away with call_api and no budget, up to a daily allowance. Anything else, or more than the allowance: request_budget first. Say what you're after in lookingFor and the operations that fit are pointed out.

lookingFor.description: Optional: what you're trying to get done, in a few words, e.g. 'test the sign-up flow of my deployed app'. Gluo points to the operations that fit, and uses it to decide what to build next. Leave out names, personal data and secrets.

name: list_services
title: List callable APIs
